Name: PC's Coffin Beds
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center][line]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/yb7jePP.png[/img]
[b]PC's Coffin Beds[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/0WZraoT.png[/img]
[line]
It's spooky season in Stardew Valley again, and your farmers been working hard all season... they've earned a proper, festive rest!
[line]
This mod adds a set of new coffins that function as beds, just in time for this year's Spirit's Eve.

The coffins come in four variations:
* Fancy Coffins
* Wooden Coffins
* Chocolate Coffins
* Lacy Coffins

The decorative version (with skulls, cobwebs, and other spooky details) is enabled by default.[/center][center]You can toggle it off in the config if you’d rather use less festive coffins.
All variants except Fancy Coffins can be toggled off if you don't want them to appear in the catalog. Check out the Images tab for previews![/center][center]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/bTXfxGv.png[/img]
You can buy the catalogue from Robin's shop for 10,000g (Requires Calcifer).

[line][/center]
